University of Kentucky researchers restore two hours of sleep in Alzheimer's models by targeting brain immune cells!

Two Hours of Sleep Restored in Alzheimer’s Brains
Evidence: scientific discovery, microglial intervention, restorative sleep
#Aletheia #Science 🌐

Targeting microglia with Pexidartinib successfully reverses sleep disruption caused by early amyloid plaque inflammation in Alzheimer's.
